Services include: 
SHOEING -- TRAINING -- MAINTENANCE -- EQUINE CONSULTING -- CLINICS -- CUSTOM HAULING -- EQUINE FACILITY DESIGN.

The services I provide are intended to improve equine performance and overall horsemanship. I am currently standing at 10 years of being a farrier. So far I have trained over a thousand head of horses - these horses have competed in all levels of rodeo (roping, barrels and poles). I am fortunate enough to train some trail versatility and ranch horses, too. Also, from East to West Coast, I custom-haul horses that value in the millions.
